correctness.rationale: Every path has a unique sorted height pair (r,s); the three predicate types are derived exactly. Explicit witnesses realize all four patterns for precisely the four listed query-pair types; all other pairs fail an inequality. Cardinality of hypotheses gives the online upper bound, and two independent threshold blocks of k values yield the lower bound. Direct finite checker of all pairs/triples and independent word-path enumeration corroborates the all-b proof.

value.rationale: The three-column strip is the first grid width where vertex shattering exceeds one and is a canonical fixed-endpoint shortest-path family. A complete formula for every shattered-support coefficient and exact four-type classification is structurally informative, not merely a brute-force small case. Unlike its uniformly bounded VC dimension, its adaptive dimension grows as 2 log2 b up to additive constants; this motivated qualitative separation holds for every height and suggests study of higher-width strip incidence systems.
